System Console.note: Repo mixes 'Consola del Sistema' and 'Consola de sistema'; standardize on 'Consola del Sistema' as a named UI area.

marketplace.note: Kept in English throughout existing es.json (e.g. 'URL del Marketplace'); treat as a proper name, masculine ('el Marketplace').

post.note: Existing translations render both 'post' and 'message' as 'mensaje'; 'publicación' appears occasionally but 'mensaje' is the majority.

thread.note: Majority rendering; a few legacy strings use 'conversación' (e.g. 'Seguir conversación') — prefer 'hilo'.

direct message.note: Abbreviation DM is not used in Spanish UI; spell out.

group message.note: Majority rendering; 'mensaje grupal' also appears — prefer 'mensaje de grupo'.

pin.note: Majority rendering ('Mensajes Destacados'); one string uses 'anclados'. Unpin: 'dejar de destacar'. Pinned: 'destacado'.

bookmark.note: No established repo rendering; 'marcador' matches browser convention. Verb: 'añadir a marcadores'.

scheduled post.note: No repo signal; 'programado' follows es convention for scheduled sends (e.g. Gmail 'programar envío').

emoji.note: Repo is split: legacy strings use 'emoticono' (slight majority) while newer ones use 'emoji'. 'Emoji' is the modern es convention (WhatsApp, Slack, Discord) and RAE-accepted; invariable-ish plural 'emojis'.

reaction.note: Verb 'reaccionar'; existing UI renders 'Add Reaction' simply as 'Reaccionar'.

out of office.note: Repo mixes 'Fuera de Oficina' and 'Fuera de la Oficina'; prefer 'Fuera de la oficina'.

guest.note: Majority rendering (~85 vs ~22 for 'invitado'). 'Invitado' also appears and collides with 'invite/invitar'; keep 'huésped' for the account type.

system admin.note: Short form 'Admin del Sistema' used where space is tight.

sign in.note: Used for both 'sign in' and 'log in' consistently in the repo.

sign out.note: Repo mixes 'Salir' (menu items) and 'Cerrar sesión'; prefer 'cerrar sesión' for both 'sign out' and 'log out'.

mute.note: For channel notifications; same verb is used in Calls for microphones.

webhook.note: Kept in English throughout existing es.json; masculine ('el webhook').

trigger word.note: Legacy strings paraphrase as 'palabra que dispara la acción/el comando'; 'palabra de activación' is the concise glossary form consistent with that intent.

plugin.note: Kept in English throughout existing es.json; masculine ('el plugin', 'los plugins'). 'Complemento' would be the alternative but is not used.

seat.note: Repo is inconsistent ('sedes' [incorrect], 'puestos pagados', 'licencias para usuarios'); 'puesto' is the standard SaaS term.

trial.note: 'Período de prueba' when spelled out; free trial: 'prueba gratuita'.

unread.note: Majority rendering; 'sin leer' also appears. Plural 'no leídos'.

channel header.note: Majority rendering; one legacy string uses 'cabecera'.

recap.note: No repo signal; 'resumen' aligns with the AI summary concept. Disambiguate from Calls 'meeting summary' ('resumen de la reunión') via context if both appear.

burn-on-read.note: No repo signal; follows messaging-app convention (Telegram 'autodestrucción'). As a message label: 'AUTODESTRUCCIÓN AL LEER'.

announcement banner.note: Existing strings use 'banner de anuncio'; one legacy string uses 'Notificaciones para todo el sistema' — prefer 'banner de anuncio'.

nickname.note: Consistent repo rendering; 'apodo' is the common alternative but is not used.

display name.note: Majority rendering; 'nombre de visualización' appears occasionally.

collapsed reply threads.note: No established repo rendering for the feature name; 'contraído' matches the UI sense of collapsed.

data retention.note: Majority rendering; 'conservación de datos' appears once. Policy: 'política de retención de datos'.

compliance export.note: Majority rendering; some legacy strings use 'Exportación de Conformidad'.

Town Square.note: Existing server translation renders the default channel name as 'General' (not a literal translation); keep for consistency with created channels.

Off-Topic.note: Existing server translation; 'Fuera de tema' would be more natural but keep the established name.

read-only.note: Prefer un-accented 'solo' per current RAE; repo mixes 'solo' and 'sólo'.
